about: Every number the systems use. One row = one constant in code.

rows.meaning: Accumulated mouse movement while blocking needed to switch guard
Main axis must exceed the other by this ratio, so diagonal wobble does not switch
Accumulated movement resets after this long without movement
Shortest time between two guard switches, so circling the mouse doesn't cycle guards
Mouse does not turn the camera while block is held (FOR HONOR guard mode)
While block is held and there's an opponent, the camera turns to face them (FOR HONOR guard mode)
Turn speed: mouse movement added per frame for each degree the player faces away from the opponent
Most mouse movement added in one frame, so big turns stay smooth
No turning when already this close to facing the opponent
Shortest time an NPC keeps a guard
Longest time an NPC keeps a guard
Chance an NPC's next guard copies the player's guard (defends)
Farthest enemy whose guard the HUD shows (about 13 m)
Master volume for FOR HONOR sounds
Wait after the first player update before showing notifications, so they aren't lost behind the loading screen
